review_description: Initially Gem Energy had the best proposal, however a representative from Arka Energy called in and offered to quote. Quote was less than others and for 39kw compared to 30kw from Gem and also using new Canadian Solar panels.Installation was organised within a week of accepting the quote. Installation took a day longer than expected by the installers due to some complications with roof rafter spacing. I am now waiting on an Arka representative to come back and help set up the monitoring system as I am having difficulty getting it to go online.
